tpms.when: 2018 with the Tire Pressure Monitor reset in iDrive
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label in the driver's door opening.
On the iDrive screen, open My Vehicle, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Start the engine but stay parked.
Drive off. After a short time above about 19 mph, the reset finishes by itself. The wheels show gray on the screen while it works.
When the wheels turn green, the reset is done.
tpms.note: Reset after every pressure adjustment and every tire or wheel change. If the wheels stay gray, the system may have a fault and should be checked. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: Only the 2018 owner's manual was checked for this model.
